messages:
ashley: Quick sync — we need to lock the Q3 launch sequencing for Dedicated GA + Redwood Optimize v1 + Private/VPC onboarding for Customer X. I put together a quick critical-path sketch, pls review.

kevin: Sending the sketch now. main constraint is quota and infra capacity. :eyes:

ashley: copying below — want to call out the hard launch criteria too (SLOs, cost targets, canary pass).

kevin: ```
Critical path (draft):
T-10w  - GPU quota & Dedicated pool provisioning (infra)  <-- blocking for throughput tests
T-8w   - Runtime perf + quantization integration (eng-runtime)
T-6w   - Optimize batching + cache suggestions in telemetry (eng-platform/Optimize)
T-5w   - RBAC, audit logs, and KMS integration (security/eng-platform)
T-4w   - Internal canary (10 customers) + perf regressions triage (eng-sre)
T-3w   - Sales/legal finalize contract terms for Customer X (sales/legal)
T-2w   - External on-prem smoke for Private (customer infra lead)
T-0    - GA release (all teams)

Launch criteria:
- P95 latency < 450ms for 2k token median under dedicated load
- Token unit cost within 12% of planned profile
- Canary failures < 0.5% and no showstopper regression
- Audit logs & KMS pass security checklist
```

sophie: Looks good. Two notes: (1) Runtime needs an extra week to validate KV cache behavior under burst; (2) Optimize depends on a stable kernel selection profile from runtime — if that slips, Optimize features can't be validated.

mike: Sales/legal: Contract draft ETA is 3 weeks. We can accelerate with product wording but need an ok from security on KMS terms.

abby: Infra: GPU quota request is in but cloud provider said "subject to capacity" — we should have a fallback plan (regional routing + smaller pool) spelled out.

eng-runtime: Agree with sophie — recommend adding a T-9w perf validation milestone specifically for KV cache. I'll add a quick perf harness.

eng-platform: On Optimize side, we can run simulated telemetry against the runtime perf harness once eng-runtime signals stable. We need the exact API contract for cache hints by T-7w.

infra-bot: quota-ticket-4482 created -> provider response expected by 2028-06-02.

ashley: Okay — updated dependency list: KV cache validation (T-9w) is an earlier blocker for Optimize and canary quality. If quota is uncertain, we route non-critical tenants to hosted fallback for canary and keep Dedicated pool limited to Customer X.

kevin: Proposed contingency: "regional fallback + smaller Dedicated pool" will cost us 18% perf hit in worst-case; confirm if product is ok with that for GA.

ashley: Product OK with contingency for GA as long as we flag it in release notes and set a post-GA optimization OKR. Not acceptable to ship without KMS/audit logs though.

mike: Legal flags — Customer X wants on-prem SLA language. We can ship VPC only and schedule on-prem later, but need to be explicit to avoid scope creep.

abby: Action items: create infra capacity runbook, request quota escalation, and document regional fallback. I'll take infra runbook.

eng-runtime: Action: build KV cache perf harness by T-9w -> owner eng-runtime (me).

eng-platform: Action: finalize API contract for cache hints by T-7w -> owner eng-platform.

ashley: I'll consolidate into a cross-team milestone board and share a zebra (milestone) view. Can we do a 30m alignment tomorrow 10:30am PT?

sophie: +1 10:30 works.

kevin: +1. I'll bring outage scenarios and perf tradeoffs.

mike: I'll bring draft legal language for VPC vs on-prem.

ashley: Great — last check: if quota ticket comes back negative, we'll switch to fallback and reconvene to rebaseline timeline. Everyone add known hard-blockers to the board before the meeting. :thumbsup:

eng-platform: Noted — adding owners to the roadmap board now.

infra-bot: reminder: quota-ticket-4482 status changed -> awaiting provider response (2028-05-29).

ashley: Thanks all. Meeting invite sent. Agenda: confirm KV cache milestone, finalize API contract owner, contingency acceptance, and customer X legal path. Short stand to lock the critical path. :calendar:
